Purpose statement: map the scaffold's cairn-specific files to pages explaining them.
The scaffold is Waymark from the showcase tree with dev-only tooling and a members fixture pruned.
This tree differs from the by-hand walkthrough, which starts from a bare project.
The scaffold begins from Waymark and already has a svelte.config.js, a shape that predates inline config.
Tree opening line naming the site root.
The claude skills directory holds four skills.
Root dotfiles: gitattributes, gitignore, and the prettier files.
The migrations directory holds the auth, preview, and login-nonce files.
The app migrations directory holds the signups schema.
Root package file, readme, and a dev script.
Source-level app declaration and html shell.
The chassis directory holds genre-free plumbing.
The content directory has a hidden dot directory with the index and media manifests.
Fragments, pages, and posts directories with a fragment, two pages, and fourteen sample posts.
The hooks module sits at the source root.
A params directory holds the md matcher.
The routes tree: admin, the site group, feeds, health, media, robots, sitemap, and root error and layout files.
The theme directory: adapter config, components, icons, islands, registry, site config, and styles.
Root config files: svelte, tsconfig, vite, vitest, and wrangler.
The gitignore and gitattributes files are really present in a scaffold from the published package.
The tree shows the entries the page names, including four skills.
The tree omits some tooling files such as the workflow directory and the vars example.
The map is incomplete too, covering cairn-specific entries and skipping plain SvelteKit and tooling files.
The hooks module mounts the auth guard behind the dev-backend gate.
The app declaration file types the platform bindings and the dev-build constant.
The root layout server module composes the site name, both navs, and the islands flag for public pages and the error page.
The by-hand page writes the first two files from nothing.
Table header for root files.
The svelte config sets the Cloudflare adapter, the origin-check handoff, and the two aliases.
The vite config wires the manifest plugin and the dev-build define.
The wrangler file binds the auth and app databases, email, the media bucket, and the origin var.
The setup command fills the resource ids in.
The migrations directory holds the auth store's schema.
The app migrations directory holds the app database's own schema, applied the same way to that database.
The package file lists the engine; the dev script runs a local in-memory admin; build produces the Worker.
The skills directory holds four agent skills, each with a stated job.
Section heading.
A hidden manifest directory is written by the build and never hand-edited.
It holds the content manifest, kept by the manifest functions, and the media asset registry when media is on.
Sample posts, pages, and fragments come pre-seeded.
Section heading.
Table header for theme files.
The adapter module covers concepts with fields, rendering, the backend, and the sidebar layout.
The icons module supplies glyphs for components and picker fields.
The components module declares the registered markdown components the registry lists.
The site-config module parses the yaml file.
The yaml file carries the site name, blurb, menus, and tag list.
The theme and site stylesheets layer over the engine roles and chassis defaults.
The components directory holds the article view and the header and footer chrome.
The islands directory holds the one hydrated banner component.
Section heading.
The layout pair mounts the shared shell and the catch-all pair serves every built-in view.
These pairs form the canonical mount, shown verbatim in the reference; sites seldom edit them.
The signups screen is a custom screen beside the catch-all, reading APP_DB, so apply that database's migration first.
Section heading.
Table header for public routes.
The catch-all renders every entry through createPublicRoutes.
The markdown twin route is matched by the md param matcher.
The archive route is a paginated post archive on the chassis slicing helper.
The preview route is the share-a-draft landing page.
The styleguide route showcases each registered component plus type scale and recipes.
The styleguide route is safe to delete if unneeded.
The feed routes serve RSS and JSON Feed through the delivery responders.
The sitemap route uses the sitemap responder.
The robots route uses the robots responder and reads a posture option.
The media route streams content-addressed bytes from the R2 bucket.
The health route is a bare, unauthenticated liveness check for a monitor.
The error page is the themed 404 and error page.
Section heading.
The chassis holds plumbing: content glob, feed and delivery literals, runtime composition, dev gate, render wiring, helpers, tokens, and prose.
The chassis is read more than edited; its own readme lists the directory file by file.
